episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: A favor for an old drinking buddy leads small time private eyes Hank and Britt down a rabbit hole of corruption in deceptively sunny Ocean Beach, California.

episodes.title: Dog and Pony
episodes.summary: Desperate for quick cash, Hank and Britt set out to capture escaped convict Mongo for a big chunk of reward money.

episodes.title: Change Partners
episodes.summary: In order to secure a loan, Hank must prove that the bank manager's wife is cheating on him. But what he discovers is much kinkier than infidelity.

episodes.title: Fustercluck
episodes.summary: Robert Lindus is back with an unusual request from jail: he wants Hank and Britt to steal a quarter of a million dollars from him. Meanwhile hank's sister is discovered camping in his attic and failing to take her psych medication.

episodes.title: Manifest Destiny
episodes.summary: Hank and Britt deal with the widening scope of the Lindus conspiracy as they try to avoid the rap for a murder they (technically) didn't commit.

episodes.title: Ring-a-Ding-Ding
episodes.summary: Hank and Britt go on a wild goose chase through Ocean Beach while searching for an engagement ring.

episodes.title: Missing Persons
episodes.summary: Hank and Britt help an amnesiac college student with the case of his missing identity.

episodes.title: Agua Caliente
episodes.summary: Separated and in danger, Hank and Britt must both work with their ex-partners to make it out of some hot water south of the border.

episodes.title: Pimp Daddy
episodes.summary: While Hank recovers from his injury, Britt teams up with a transvestite hooker to solve the death of her friend.

episodes.title: Asunder
episodes.summary: Fighting the urge to drink on Gretchen's wedding day, Hank stumbles back onto the radar of the conspiracy threatening Ocean Beach.

episodes.title: Sins of the Past
episodes.summary: Hank gets a second shot at the rape case that got him ejected from the police department in a mystery spanning multiple time periods.

episodes.title: Quid Pro Quo
episodes.summary: Hank, Britt, and new ally, Laura Ross, unravel the Ocean Beach conspiracy, which puts them and everyone they love in immediate danger.

episodes.title: Hail Mary
episodes.summary: Still reeling from his loss, Hank is out of options and out of time. Britt is faced with a decision that will change his future.
